pull-request-header: Merging this PR publishes the release below as a GitHub pre-release.
pull-request-footer: Forks: `nix run .#upstream` opens the PR that merges this release, and the `sync-upstream` workflow runs it every Monday ([docs/updates.md](https://github.com/axelhamil/nixos-forge/blob/main/docs/updates.md#your-fork-follows-the-starter)). Read the breaking changes first: each one says how to migrate.
